meaningEn: 점메추 is short for 점심 메뉴 추천: "recommend a lunch menu". You are asking a friend to pick lunch.
situationEn: Asking a friend right before lunch.

meaningEn: 갓생 means living a diligent, productive life.
situationEn: Telling a friend about your new routine: gym, study, early mornings.

meaningEn: 꿀잼 means really fun: 꿀 (honey) plus a short form of 재미 (fun).
situationEn: Telling a close friend how much you enjoyed a film.

meaningEn: 오운완 is short for 오늘 운동 완료: today’s workout is done.
situationEn: After a workout, sharing a small achievement with a friend. A casual spoken or message-style expression.

korean: 이 노래는 완전 내 취향 저격이야.
meaningEn: 취향 저격 means something is exactly your taste: it hits the spot for you.
situationEn: Listening to music with a close friend and saying why you want to hear it again.

meaningEn: 가성비 means value for money, short for 가격 대비 성능: quality compared with the price.
situationEn: Recommending an affordable restaurant to a classmate after eating there.

meaningEn: 집콕 means staying home: 집 (home) plus 콕, suggesting staying put in one place.
situationEn: Telling a close friend that you want a quiet weekend at home.

korean: 시험 공부 꿀팁 좀 알려 줘.
meaningEn: 꿀팁 means a really useful tip: 꿀 (honey) plus 팁 (tip).
situationEn: Asking a close classmate for helpful study advice before exams.
